summary: Resets a buffered file stream context back to read mode: validates the mode byte at this+0x5C equals 'r' (114), resets buffer state fields, reinitializes the allocator, then either seeks to the data size at this+0x5D or closes the handle. Returns -1 on null this or wrong mode. Part of the file/audio-stream I/O system, called by AudioStreamBufferRead.

operations.description: Null check on this: when this is null the function exits early returning -1.
Mode validation: the byte at this+0x5C must equal 114 ('r'); otherwise return -1.
Save the stream/handle value at this+0x44 into local v2 before the buffer state is reset.
Clear the remaining-bytes field at this+0x38 to 0.
Clear the EOF/error-flag field at this+0x3C to 0.
Clear the field at this+0x4 to 0.
Reset the buffer-position field at this+0x0 to the saved handle value v2.
Reinitialize the allocator object: this+0x4C = sub_536E90(0).
Branch on the data-size field at this+0x5D: a non-zero value selects the seek path, zero selects the close path.
Reset/init context state fields via ArithmeticComparison_5620(this).
Seek the stream to the data position: sub_587F64(value at this+0x40, data size at this+0x5D, 0).
Return the result of the seek call on the seek path.
Close the file handle via sub_58AFE1(value at this+0x40) when no seek is needed.
